text: At Squawk Erin, the lamps burned low. The crew was loud with tales of old. A battered map was left on board. They set their sails and let winds blow. Soon may the pirate quest run. With blade and sail and tropic sun. One day when the loot is won. We'll take our coin and go. They packed their haul in the market square. For punch and fruit and truths to spare. They hired a scout with a staring glare. The crew was good to go. Soon may the pirate quest run. With blade and sail and tropic sun. One day when the loot is won. We'll take our coin and go. A shadow rose with sails like night. The crew hurled forth and joined the fight. They won the deck by strength and might. And claimed the prize below. Soon may the pirate quest run. We'll take our coin and go. The Spanish came at break of day. They fought them fast and seized the bay. An English flag got in their way. But pirates steal the show, ha-ha.
